I've uploaded a code repository in the directory `/src/libxml2`. Consider the following issue description:

<issue_description>
A heap-buffer-overflow in xmlParsePubidLiteral (parser.c): when parsing PublicID/external ID literals (via xmlParseExternalID/xmlParseEntityDecl), a buffer is resized/mis-sized leading to a one-byte write past the end of a heap allocation. This results in heap memory corruption that can cause crashes and may be exploitable for further attacks (e.g., arbitrary code execution).

import cpp

from Function f, CallExpr call
where f.getName() = "xmlParsePubidLiteral" and
  call.getTarget().getName() = "xmlRealloc" and
  call.getEnclosingFunction() = f
select call, "xmlRealloc called inside xmlParsePubidLiteral; verify resize argument matches the new capacity (risk of heap overflow if old size is used)."

import cpp

from Function f, FunctionCall call
where f.getName() = "xmlParsePubidLiteral" and
  call.getTarget().getName() = "xmlRealloc" and
  call.getEnclosingFunction() = f
select call, "Call to xmlRealloc inside xmlParsePubidLiteral; ensure the reallocation size argument uses the computed new capacity (newSize), not the old size."
